records.reason: SYNAPSE tests intranasal esketamine in people with treatment-resistant major depressive disorder. The card's indication includes major depression generally; suicidal thoughts are included, not an exclusive eligibility restriction. The trial therefore falls within the recorded claim, although it does not establish efficacy for acute suicidality. Its separate title, population and source remain visible. The low-confidence diagnostic split alone does not justify rejecting the association.
